description: A React functional component that uses PIXI.js to visualize a Game of Life grid with organic, multicolor metaball graphics. It handles rendering of cells based on their age, with interaction capabilities for clicking on cells when the simulation is paused. The component initializes, updates, and cleans up a PIXI application to animate the grid.

methods.name: cellColor(age)
methods.description: Utility function to select the cell color based on its age, creating a multicolor gradient for visualization.

methods.name: OrganicWebGLGrid({ grid, cellSize, onCellClick, running, theme })
methods.description: React component that renders a WebGL-based, organic visual representation of a Game of Life grid, supporting interaction and theme-based coloring.
